text:
Alex (PM): Quick sync — proposing an interop routing contracts PR for the long-term roadmap. We need launch hypotheses, gating criteria, and a customer commitment spreadsheet by EOW.
Maria (Eng): Thoughts on implementation? We can do policy DSL + small control plane changes, but will take ~2 sprints to stabilize.
Sam (Arch): Agree. Key risk: cross-region affinity + tenant isolation edge cases. Need a policy precedence model and evict/soft-evict flows. Also we should define fallback variants.
Jess (SRE): Rollout ops: canary by tenant band, 1% traffic -> 10% over 3 days. Need runbook entries for fail-open vs fail-close. Also alert on increased retry latencies.
Oliver (Sales): Customers asking for SLA guarantees and per-region residency. We can promise pilot SLAs for Dedicated customers, but need exact metrics.
Alex (PM): Acceptance criteria proposal: 1) policy DSL v1 docs, 2) canary plan + runbook, 3) perf regressions <5% p50 tail, 4) rollback thresholds defined.
Maria (Eng): Config snippet for policy precedence:
```
policy:
  precedence:
    - region_affinity
    - tenant_quota
    - cost_tier
```
Sam (Arch): We'll need telemetry hooks: per-request route tags, model-variant metadata, and end-to-end traces. Add schema to tracing proto.
Jess (SRE): Cost note — cross-region routing could add egress agg ~10-15% traffic. Estimate to infra: +$Xk/month in staging. Can we gate with capacity contracts?
Oliver (Sales): I'll surface gating to 2 pilot customers (banking and ecom). Need legal on data residency for Private deployments.
Alex (PM): Action items: Maria + Sam to draft policy DSL + trace schema by Wed; Jess to write runbook template; Oliver to collect pilot commitment by Thu. We'll reconvene Fri for launch criteria check.
roadmap-bot: Reminder — weekly product-arch sync scheduled Fri 10:00am. :calendar:
Alex (PM): Thanks all — please add blockers as thread replies. :thumbsup:
